personalMenu.premiumHintViewer: Private and premium 1-to-1 shows are coordinated in your messages and on live pages.

viewerLists.favoritesEmpty: You are not following anyone yet. Find models on the home page or Discover.

authLogin.title: Log in
authLogin.subtitle: Welcome back. Sign in to chat, send tips, and join private shows.

authRegister.title: Create account
authRegister.subtitle: Default role is viewer; creator promotion is done by admin.
authRegister.ageConfirm: I confirm I am at least 18 years old and accept the terms of service.
authRegister.ageError: You must confirm you are at least 18 years old.

becomeStreamer.title: Become a streamer
becomeStreamer.subtitle: Upload a valid government ID and a selfie holding it next to your face. After submission your account becomes a creator account and you can go live from Studio.
becomeStreamer.idDocumentHint: JPEG, PNG, WebP or PDF, max 5 MB
becomeStreamer.selfieHint: Clear photo of your face next to the document. JPEG, PNG or WebP, max 5 MB
becomeStreamer.success: Verification submitted. You can open Studio and go live.
becomeStreamer.alreadyCreator: Your account is already a creator.
becomeStreamer.needLogin: Sign in to submit your documents.

discover.title: Discover creators
discover.subtitle: Search by name or tag, open a live stream, or send a message.
discover.noPublicStreams: No public live streams right now.
discover.noTagMatch: No creators match tag «{tag}». Try another tag.
discover.shortcutNewCreatorsAria: Sort by newest and scroll to the new creators carousel
discover.advancedHint: Optional: restrict matches to creator couples (works with filters above).

creatorProfile.noBio: This creator has not written a bio yet.
creatorProfile.tipFooter: Tips are sent from the live chat.

errors.balance: Insufficient balance — top up your wallet.
errors.own: You cannot purchase from your own profile.

liveChat.reasonLogin: Log in to write in chat during the live stream.
liveChat.reasonSpy: In spy mode you cannot write in chat.
liveChat.reasonPremium: Only the streamer, the Premium 1v1 viewer, or staff can write.
liveChat.reasonBadToken: Invalid session: please log in again.
liveChat.reasonClosed: The streamer has closed the chat.
liveChat.reasonTooFast: You are sending messages too fast — slow down.
liveChat.reasonDuplicate: You recently sent this same message.
liveChat.reasonModeration: Message blocked (links, length, or automatic moderation).
liveChat.title: Public chat · real-time messages
liveChat.privateLoginHint: During Premium 1v1 an account is required to write (spies cannot message).
liveChat.genericLoginHint: Log in to write in chat during the live stream.
liveChat.chatDisabledBanner: The streamer has closed the chat.
liveChat.emptyPlaceholder: Be the first to write in chat.
liveChat.placeholderWrite: Write a message (emoji from the smile icon)
liveChat.publicChatHint: Moderated public chat: messages are filtered on the server before everyone sees them (suspicious links, repeated spam).
liveChat.footerHints: Emoji via ☺ button. GIF: paste HTTPS Tenor (.gif/.webp/.mp4) or Giphy static links only. Highlight at most once per minute: prefix with ! attached to text (e.g. !thanks).

wallet.title: Top up your account
wallet.subtitle: Tokens are used for chat tips, private shows, spy mode, group tickets, and gallery unlocks. Pay by card via Stripe Checkout — same flow as major live cam sites.
wallet.balanceSyncFootnote: Near-real-time balance: auto-sync while you browse and right after tips or Stripe purchases.
wallet.indicativeEuroLine: ≈ {eur}: illustrative value from the best €/token pack currently shown — not equal to withdrawal or cashback.
wallet.creatorSaldoSubtitle: Tokens after Synthra fees — convert to Euro payouts via Studio (manual requests; Stripe Connect or bank depending on admin setup).
wallet.trustStrip: Secure payments · processed by Stripe (Visa, Mastercard, more where available)
wallet.buySectionHint: Larger packs include bonus tokens for a better €/token rate.
wallet.fallbackBanner: Offline price list: the API is unreachable, showing the standard catalog that matches the server. Start the API for live pricing.
wallet.asideTokensBody: Virtual currency for this site: they stay in your balance until you spend them (tips, privates, gallery, etc.). One-off purchases — no subscription required.
wallet.useTip: Tips and tip menu from live chat
wallet.paymentsBody: You are redirected to Stripe Checkout. After payment, tokens credit on webhook confirmation (usually within seconds).
wallet.cryptoBody: Generate a manual request: the system records the package and shows the wallet, network, and reference to send to support/admin after payment.
wallet.cryptoMissing: Crypto is not configured on the backend: missing CRYPTO_WALLET_USDT_TRC20, CRYPTO_WALLET_USDT_ERC20, or CRYPTO_WALLET_BTC.
wallet.cryptoInstructions: No automatic credit: send payment and reference to admin. Tokens move from pending to completed after manual verification.
wallet.payoutBody: Request a withdrawal of creator earnings. The amount is deducted immediately from the creator wallet and stays pending until admin approval or payment.
wallet.legalNote: 18+ only. Digital token purchases are for on-site use; refunds only as required by law / Stripe policy.
wallet.paidDetail: Balance updates after Stripe confirms. If tokens do not show instantly, refresh in a few seconds.
wallet.cancelDetail: No charge. You can try again anytime.
wallet.stripeMissing: Stripe is not configured on the backend (missing STRIPE_SECRET_KEY).
wallet.needLoginBuy: You must be logged in to buy tokens.
